methods.title: Sum two arithmetic sequences
methods.titleZh: 分别求两个等差数列之和
steps: The first five-term sequence has average $(1+41)/2=21$, so its sum is $5\cdot21=105$.
The second has average $(9+49)/2=29$, so its sum is $5\cdot29=145$. Therefore the total is $105+145=250$.
stepsZh: 第一组五项的平均数为 $(1+41)/2=21$，所以和为 $5\cdot21=105$。

methods.title: Use place value
steps: Adding by place value gives $0.2+0.04+0.006=0.246$.

methods.title: Align decimal places
steps: Write the numbers with four decimal places: $0.9900,0.9099,0.9000,0.9090,0.9009$.
All have tenths digit $9$, but $0.9900$ has hundredths digit $9$ while each other number has hundredths digit $0$. Hence $0.99$ is greatest.
stepsZh: 十分位都是 $9$，但 $0.9900$ 的百分位为 $9$，其余各数的百分位均为 $0$，所以 $0.99$ 最大。

methods.title: Estimate with compatible numbers
steps: Use $401\approx400$ and $0.205\approx0.2$.
Then $401/0.205\approx400/0.2=2000$, so $2000$ is the closest listed value.

methods.title: Follow the order of operations
steps: Evaluate the parentheses first: $6/3=2$.

amc8-1989-q6.summary: A number line has equally spaced ticks. From the tick labelled $0$ to the tick labelled $20$ there are five equal intervals. The tick labelled $y$ is three of those intervals to the right of $0$. Find $y$.
amc8-1989-q6.summaryZh: 一条数轴的刻度等距。从标有 $0$ 的刻度到标有 $20$ 的刻度共有五个相等区间；标有 $y$ 的刻度位于 $0$ 右侧第三个区间的端点。求 $y$。

methods.title: Find the value of one interval
steps: Five equal intervals cover $20-0=20$, so each interval represents $20/5=4$.
The point $y$ is three intervals from $0$, hence $y=0+3\cdot4=12$.
stepsZh: 五个相等区间覆盖 $20-0=20$，所以每格表示 $20/5=4$。

amc8-1989-q7.summary: Twenty quarters and ten dimes have the same value as ten quarters and $n$ dimes. Find $n$.
amc8-1989-q7.summaryZh: 二十枚二角五分硬币与十枚一角硬币的总价值，等于十枚二角五分硬币与 $n$ 枚一角硬币的总价值。求 $n$。

methods.title: Write a cents equation
steps: In cents, the equality is $20\cdot25+10\cdot10=10\cdot25+10n$.
stepsZh: 以美分为单位，有 $20\cdot25+10\cdot10=10\cdot25+10n$。

methods.title: Cancel common coins
steps: Cancel ten quarters from both collections. The remaining ten quarters and ten dimes must equal $n$ dimes.
Ten quarters equal $250$ cents, or $25$ dimes. Together with the original ten dimes this gives $n=25+10=35$.
stepsZh: 两边各去掉十枚二角五分硬币，剩下的十枚二角五分硬币和十枚一角硬币应等值于 $n$ 枚一角硬币。
十枚二角五分硬币值 $250$ 美分，即 $25$ 枚一角硬币；再加原有的十枚，得 $n=25+10=35$。

methods.title: Distribute the common product
steps: Since $2\cdot3\cdot4=24$, distribute $24$ to each fraction.
stepsZh: 因为 $2\cdot3\cdot4=24$，把 $24$ 分配到括号内各项。

amc8-1989-q9.summary: The ratio of boys to girls in a class is $2:3$, and there are $30$ students. What percentage of the class are boys?
amc8-1989-q9.summaryZh: 某班男生与女生人数之比为 $2:3$，全班共有 $30$ 人。男生占全班的百分之几？

methods.title: Use ratio parts
steps: There are $2+3=5$ equal ratio parts, of which boys occupy $2$.
Therefore the fraction of boys is $2/5=0.4=40\%$. (Indeed, $30\cdot2/5=12$ boys.)
stepsZh: 比例总份数为 $2+3=5$，其中男生占 $2$ 份。

amc8-1989-q10.summary: Find the smaller angle between the hour hand and minute hand of a clock at exactly $7{:}00$.
amc8-1989-q10.summaryZh: 求时钟在正好 $7{:}00$ 时，时针与分针之间的较小夹角。

methods.title: Count hour intervals
steps: Adjacent hour marks are separated by $360^\circ/12=30^\circ$.
At $7{:}00$, the hands are five hour intervals apart along the shorter path, so the angle is $5\cdot30^\circ=150^\circ$.
stepsZh: 相邻整点刻度相隔 $360^\circ/12=30^\circ$。
在 $7{:}00$，两针沿较短方向相隔五个小时刻度，因此夹角为 $5\cdot30^\circ=150^\circ$。

amc8-1989-q11.summary: A bow-tie figure consists of two outlined triangles meeting at one central vertex. A small square is attached to the upper-left outer vertex. The entire figure is reflected across a vertical dashed line. Which image results?
amc8-1989-q11.summaryZh: 一个蝴蝶结形图案由两个轮廓三角形在中央顶点相接组成，一个小正方形附在左上方的外顶点。将整个图案关于一条竖直虚线作轴对称，所得图形是哪一个？
amc8-1989-q11.answer: B. The square is at the upper-right outer vertex, with every left-right slope reversed.
amc8-1989-q11.answerZh: B．小正方形移到右上方外顶点，所有斜边的左右倾斜方向反转。

methods.title: Apply the reflection rule
steps: Reflection across a vertical line preserves every point's height and perpendicular distance from the line, but reverses left and right.
Thus the upper-left square moves to the corresponding upper-right vertex, while all diagonal slopes reverse. This is choice B.
stepsZh: 关于竖直直线的轴对称保持每个点的高度及到对称轴的垂直距离，但左右互换。
所以左上方的小正方形移到对应的右上方顶点，各斜线的倾斜方向反转，对应选项 B。

methods.title: Simplify numerator and denominator
steps: The numerator is $1-1/3=2/3$ and the denominator is $1-1/2=1/2$.

amc8-1989-q13.summary: Which decimal-scaled expression is equal to $\dfrac{9}{7\cdot53}$?
amc8-1989-q13.summaryZh: 下列哪一个经过小数缩放的式子与 $\dfrac{9}{7\cdot53}$ 相等？

methods.title: Scale numerator and denominator equally
steps: Multiplying or dividing both numerator and denominator of a fraction by the same nonzero number preserves its value.
Divide both the numerator $9$ and the factor $7$ in the denominator by $10$: $\frac{9}{7\cdot53}=\frac{0.9}{0.7\cdot53}$.
stepsZh: 分数的分子、分母同时乘或除以同一个非零数，分数值不变。
把分子中的 $9$ 与分母因子 $7$ 同时除以 $10$：$\frac{9}{7\cdot53}=\frac{0.9}{0.7\cdot53}$。

amc8-1989-q14.summary: Use each of the digits $2,4,5,6,9$ exactly once to form a three-digit number minus a two-digit number. What is the least possible positive difference?
amc8-1989-q14.summaryZh: 将数字 $2,4,5,6,9$ 各使用一次，组成一个三位数减去一个两位数。所得正差的最小值是多少？

methods.title: Minimise the minuend and maximise the subtrahend
methods.titleZh: 使被减数尽量小、减数尽量大
steps: Every three-digit number using these digits is at least $245$: choose the smallest possible hundreds digit $2$, then arrange the remaining chosen tens and ones increasingly.
With $245$ fixed, the unused digits $9$ and $6$ form the largest possible two-digit number, $96$.
Thus the least difference is $245-96=149$. Any larger three-digit number or smaller two-digit number cannot improve it.
stepsZh: 用这些数字组成的三位数至少为 $245$：百位取最小的 $2$，再使所选十位、个位尽量小。
确定 $245$ 后，剩余数字 $9,6$ 能组成的最大两位数是 $96$。
所以最小正差为 $245-96=149$。增大三位数或减小两位数都不会得到更小的差。

amc8-1989-q15.summary: In parallelogram $ABCD$, $AD=10$. Point $E$ lies on $AD$ with $ED=6$, and $BE$ is perpendicular to $AD$ with $BE=8$. Find the area of trapezoid $BEDC$.
amc8-1989-q15.summaryZh: 在平行四边形 $ABCD$ 中，$AD=10$。点 $E$ 位于 $AD$ 上，$ED=6$；$BE\perp AD$ 且 $BE=8$。求梯形 $BEDC$ 的面积。

methods.title: Use the trapezoid formula
steps: Because $ABCD$ is a parallelogram, $BC=AD=10$. The parallel sides of trapezoid $BEDC$ are $ED=6$ and $BC=10$.
Their perpendicular separation is $BE=8$, so the area is $\frac12(6+10)\cdot8=64$.
stepsZh: 因为 $ABCD$ 是平行四边形，所以 $BC=AD=10$。梯形 $BEDC$ 的两条平行边为 $ED=6$ 与 $BC=10$。
两平行边间的垂直距离为 $BE=8$，故面积为 $\frac12(6+10)\cdot8=64$。

methods.title: Subtract a triangle from the parallelogram
methods.titleZh: 用平行四边形减去三角形
steps: The parallelogram has base $AD=10$ and height $BE=8$, so its area is $80$.
Since $AE=AD-ED=4$, right triangle $ABE$ has area $\frac12\cdot4\cdot8=16$.
Therefore trapezoid $BEDC$ has area $80-16=64$.
stepsZh: 平行四边形的底为 $AD=10$、高为 $BE=8$，面积为 $80$。
因为 $AE=AD-ED=4$，直角三角形 $ABE$ 的面积为 $\frac12\cdot4\cdot8=16$。
所以梯形 $BEDC$ 的面积为 $80-16=64$。

amc8-1989-q16.summary: In how many ways can $47$ be written as the sum of two prime numbers? Order does not matter.
amc8-1989-q16.summaryZh: $47$ 有多少种表示为两个质数之和的方式？不计次序。

methods.title: Use parity of primes
steps: The sum $47$ is odd. A sum of two odd primes would be even, so one prime would have to be the only even prime, $2$.
The other number would be $47-2=45$, which is composite. Hence there are no representations.
stepsZh: $47$ 是奇数，而两个奇质数之和为偶数，所以其中一个质数只能是唯一的偶质数 $2$。
另一个数应为 $47-2=45$，但 $45$ 是合数。因此没有任何表示方法。

amc8-1989-q17.summary: A number $N$ satisfies $9<N<17$. Which of $8,10,12,14,16$ could be the average of $6,10,N$?

methods.title: Bound the mean and test the candidate
steps: From $9<N<17$, $25<6+10+N<33$. Dividing by $3$ gives $25/3<\text{mean}<11$.
Among the choices only $10$ lies in this interval. It is attainable because mean $10$ requires $6+10+N=30$, so $N=14$, which satisfies the condition.
stepsZh: 选项中只有 $10$ 位于此区间。若平均数为 $10$，则 $6+10+N=30$，解得 $N=14$，确实满足条件。

amc8-1989-q18.summary: A calculator displays $00032$ and has a reciprocal key $1/x$. What is the smallest positive number of presses of this key that returns the display to $00032$?
amc8-1989-q18.summaryZh: 计算器显示 $00032$，并有倒数键 $1/x$。至少按多少次该键，显示才会回到 $00032$？要求按键次数为正。

methods.title: Use the reciprocal as an involution
methods.titleZh: 利用取倒数的对合性质
steps: One press changes $32$ to $1/32$, so one press does not return the display.
A second press gives $1/(1/32)=32$. Thus two presses are necessary and sufficient.
stepsZh: 按一次把 $32$ 变为 $1/32$，所以一次不能恢复原数。
再按一次得到 $1/(1/32)=32$。因此至少且恰好需要两次。

amc8-1989-q19.summary: A cumulative-spending graph (in millions of dollars) shows about $2.2$ at the end of May and about $4.7$ at the end of August. Estimate the company's spending during June, July, and August.
amc8-1989-q19.summaryZh: 一幅累计支出折线图（单位：百万美元）显示：五月末约为 $2.2$，八月末约为 $4.7$。估计公司在六月、七月和八月三个月的支出。

methods.title: Subtract cumulative totals
steps: Summer spending from June through August is the increase after May and through August.
Subtract the two cumulative readings: $4.7-2.2=2.5$ million dollars.
stepsZh: 六月至八月的支出等于五月末以后、八月末以前的累计增量。
用两个累计读数作差：$4.7-2.2=2.5$（百万美元）。

amc8-1989-q20.summary: A cube net has four faces in a horizontal row labelled $6,2,4,5$ from left to right; face $1$ is attached above face $2$, and face $3$ below face $2$. After folding the net, what is the greatest possible sum of the three face labels meeting at one vertex?
amc8-1989-q20.summaryZh: 一个正方体展开图的四个面从左到右排成一行，依次标为 $6,2,4,5$；标有 $1$ 的面接在 $2$ 的上方，标有 $3$ 的面接在 $2$ 的下方。折成正方体后，同一顶点处相交的三个面上的数字之和最大是多少？

methods.title: Identify opposite pairs
steps: Folding the net gives opposite pairs $(6,4)$, $(2,5)$, and $(1,3)$.
Three faces at a vertex contain exactly one face from each opposite pair. To maximise the sum choose the larger label from each pair: $6+5+3=14$.
These three pairwise non-opposite faces do meet at one vertex, so the bound is attained.
stepsZh: 一个顶点处的三个面恰好从每对相对面中各取一个。为使和最大，应分别取较大者，得 $6+5+3=14$。
这三个面两两不相对，确实能够相交于同一顶点，故该最大值可达到。

amc8-1989-q21.summary: A farmer has $128$ apples. He sells $25\%$ of them to Jill, then sells $25\%$ of the remaining apples to June, and finally gives one apple to his teacher. How many apples remain?
amc8-1989-q21.summaryZh: 一位农夫有 $128$ 个苹果。他先把其中的 $25\%$ 卖给 Jill，再把剩余苹果的 $25\%$ 卖给 June，最后送给老师一个苹果。还剩多少个？

methods.title: Apply each change in order
steps: After selling $25\%$, the farmer keeps $75\%$: $128\cdot\frac34=96$ apples.
He again keeps $75\%$ of the remainder: $96\cdot\frac34=72$.
After giving away one more apple, $72-1=71$ remain.
stepsZh: 第二次又保留剩余量的 $75\%$：$96\cdot\frac34=72$ 个。
再送出一个，剩下 $72-1=71$ 个。

amc8-1989-q22.summary: Successive lines are formed by shifting one place through the repeating letters $A,J,H,S,M,E$ and simultaneously one place through the repeating digits $1,9,8,9$. After how many lines do both the original letter alignment and the original digit alignment first reappear together?
amc8-1989-q22.summaryZh: 逐行把循环字母串 $A,J,H,S,M,E$ 向前移动一位，同时把循环数字串 $1,9,8,9$ 也向前移动一位。经过多少行后，字母与数字的初始排列第一次同时重现？

methods.title: Find the least common multiple
steps: The letter pattern returns after every $6$ shifts, while the digit pattern returns after every $4$ shifts.
Both return together after the least positive common multiple: $\operatorname{lcm}(6,4)=12$.
stepsZh: 字母排列每移动 $6$ 次恢复一次，数字排列每移动 $4$ 次恢复一次。
二者第一次同时恢复所需次数为最小公倍数：$\operatorname{lcm}(6,4)=12$。

amc8-1989-q23.summary: An artist builds a ground-standing sculpture from $14$ unit cubes and paints every exposed face, but not the faces on the ground or between cubes. An equivalent description of the diagram is: the top projection has $10$ occupied unit positions; the exposed front and back faces number $6$ each; and the two side directions together contain $11$ exposed unit faces. What area is painted?
amc8-1989-q23.summaryZh: 一位艺术家用 $14$ 个棱长为 $1$ 米的单位正方体在地面上搭成雕塑，并给所有外露面涂色；接触地面或相邻正方体的面不涂色。原图可等价描述为：俯视投影有 $10$ 个被占据的单位格；正面、背面各有 $6$ 个外露单位面；左右两个方向合计有 $11$ 个外露单位面。求涂色面积。

methods.title: Count exposed faces by direction
steps: Each of the $10$ occupied top-view positions contributes one exposed top face. Bottom faces are on the ground and are not painted.
The vertical exposed faces total $6+6+11=23$ from the front, back, and two side directions.
Every face is a $1\text{ m}\times1\text{ m}$ square, so the painted area is $10+23=33$ square metres.
stepsZh: 俯视投影中的每个被占据位置贡献一个外露顶面，共 $10$ 个；底面接触地面，不涂色。
正面、背面及左右方向的外露竖直面共 $6+6+11=23$ 个。
每个面面积为 $1\text{ m}\times1\text{ m}=1\text{ m}^2$，所以涂色面积为 $10+23=33$ 平方米。

amc8-1989-q24.summary: A square sheet of side $4$ is folded in half along a vertical line, producing a $2\times4$ folded rectangle. A cut parallel to the fold divides that folded rectangle into two $1\times4$ strips. When unfolded, there is one $2\times4$ rectangle and two $1\times4$ rectangles. What is the ratio of the perimeter of a small rectangle to the perimeter of the large rectangle?
amc8-1989-q24.summaryZh: 一张边长为 $4$ 的正方形纸沿竖直中线对折，得到一个 $2\times4$ 的长方形；再沿与折痕平行的直线把折后长方形切成两个 $1\times4$ 的纸条。展开后得到一个 $2\times4$ 长方形和两个 $1\times4$ 长方形。求小长方形周长与大长方形周长之比。

methods.title: Compare the two perimeters
steps: A small $1\times4$ rectangle has perimeter $2(1+4)=10$.
The large $2\times4$ rectangle has perimeter $2(2+4)=12$.
The requested ratio is $10/12=5/6$.
stepsZh: 一个 $1\times4$ 小长方形的周长为 $2(1+4)=10$。
$2\times4$ 大长方形的周长为 $2(2+4)=12$。

amc8-1989-q25.summary: Two fair independent spinners have equal sectors. The first spinner is labelled $5,3,8,4$ and the second is labelled $6,9,7$. Find the probability that the sum of the two results is even.
amc8-1989-q25.summaryZh: 两个相互独立且各扇区等大的转盘：第一个标有 $5,3,8,4$，第二个标有 $6,9,7$。求两次结果之和为偶数的概率。

methods.title: Use parity probabilities
steps: An even sum occurs when both results have the same parity.
The first spinner has two odd and two even labels, so each parity has probability $1/2$. The second has two odd and one even label, with probabilities $2/3$ and $1/3$.
stepsZh: 两数之和为偶数，当且仅当两次结果奇偶性相同。
第一个转盘有两个奇数、两个偶数，两种奇偶性的概率均为 $1/2$；第二个有两个奇数、一个偶数，概率分别为 $2/3$、$1/3$。

methods.title: Count equally likely outcomes
steps: There are $4\cdot3=12$ equally likely ordered pairs.
Odd-odd gives $2\cdot2=4$ even-sum pairs and even-even gives $2\cdot1=2$ more.
Thus $6$ of $12$ outcomes work, so the probability is $6/12=1/2$.
stepsZh: 共有 $4\cdot3=12$ 个等可能有序结果。
奇数配奇数产生 $2\cdot2=4$ 个偶数和，偶数配偶数再产生 $2\cdot1=2$ 个。
共有 $6$ 个符合条件的结果，概率为 $6/12=1/2$。
